_info: ShareWatch 0.7.5 - copy this file as xx.json (xx = language code, e.g. de.json), set _name and translate only the values. Keep the keys (Romanian text) and {0}, {1} unchanged.
Eroare: acces refuzat - rulează ca Admin: Error: access denied - run as Administrator
Acces refuzat. Rulează aplicația ca Admi: Access denied. Run the application as Administrator to see accesses.
Pornește automat la autentificare, direc: Starts automatically at sign-in, straight to the tray.
Nu am putut modifica pornirea automată (: Could not change automatic start (run as Administrator).
Acces refuzat - rulează aplicația ca Adm: Access denied - run the application as Administrator to see connections.
Bifează folderele partajate care vor fi: Check the shared folders to monitor (notifications and log). Changes apply immediately. Administrative shares (C$, ADMIN$ etc.) are disabled by default.
Ștergi tot conținutul jurnalului? Operaț: Delete the entire log? This cannot be undone.
Afișează notificare la accesarea foldere: Show a notification when shared folders are accessed
Ignoră accesările făcute de pe acest cal: Ignore access made from this computer
Pornește automat cu Windows (în tray, cu: Start with Windows (in the tray, with administrator rights, no UAC prompt)
Pauză între notificările pentru fișiere,: Pause between file notifications for the same PC and folder (seconds):
Deschide fereastra cu un singur clic pe: Open the window with a single click on the tray icon
Alte limbi: fișiere language\\xx.json lâ: Other languages: language\xx.json files next to the executable (see README).
Setările se salvează automat în sharewat: Settings are saved automatically in sharewatch.ini, next to the executable. Closing the window (X) keeps the application running in the tray; to stop it use Exit from the tray icon menu.
Could not change automatic start. Run the application as Administrator.
Monitorizează accesările la folderele pa: Monitors access to this computer's shared folders (SMB): shows notifications with the IP and name of the accessing computer and keeps an access log.
Închide imediat conexiunile calculatoare: Immediately close connections from computers on the block list
IP și/sau nume de calculator, separate p: IP and/or computer name, separated by spaces (e.g. 192.168.1.50 OFFICE-PC). The list is saved in blocklist.txt next to the executable and can also be edited directly; changes apply within a few seconds.
„{0}” este chiar acest calculator și nu: "{0}" is this computer and cannot be blocked.
"{0}" is already on the block list.
Nu am putut scrie fișierul blocklist.txt: Could not write the blocklist.txt file.
Ascunde partajările administrative (C$,: Hide administrative shares (C$, ADMIN$ etc.) from the lists
Notificare (fără sunet) când un calculat: Notification (silent) when a blocked computer is disconnected
Blochează și în Windows Firewall (portur: Also block in Windows Firewall (SMB ports 139 and 445): the computer cannot connect at all
Elimină regulile ShareWatch din firewall: Remove ShareWatch rules from the firewall
Elimini regula ShareWatch din Windows Fi: Remove the ShareWatch rule from Windows Firewall and stop firewall blocking? The block list stays unchanged.
Activă, dar nu există adrese IP de bloca: Enabled, but there are no IP addresses to block.
No ShareWatch rule in the firewall.
Acces refuzat - rulează aplicația ca Adm: Access denied - run the application as Administrator.
A share with this name already exists.
Calea nu există sau nu este un folder lo: The path does not exist or is not a local folder.
The computer is no longer connected.
Selectează o partajare obișnuită (nu adm: Select a regular (not administrative) share from the list.
Permisiunile NTFS ale folderului se apli: The folder's NTFS permissions still apply. For network access, users also need rights on the folder (Security tab).
Folderul trebuie să fie pe acest calcula: The folder must be on this computer, not on the network.
Numele partajării trebuie să aibă între: The share name must be 1 to 80 characters long.
Numele partajării conține caractere nepe: The share name contains invalid characters: \ / [ ] : | < > + = ; , ? * "
